### AI-Research Notes (WO2 pipeline — sources, blanks, and cross-language checks)

**Sources cited across this entry:**
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PsycCRITIQUES
- https://www.apa.org/pubs/databases/psyccritiques

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **ai_policy.leniency_1_5 / ai_policy.gate**: Journal discontinued 2017-12-31, before generative-AI disclosure policies existed anywhere in scholarly publishing; no journal-specific policy page exists. Only APA's org-wide general policy is findable, and it cannot be honestly attributed as this title's own policy.
- **positioning.methods_welcome / positioning.accepts_now (topical detail)**: No 2024-2026 articles, special issues, or CFPs exist because the journal has not published since 2017; nothing current to infer scope from.
- **experiential.review_time_months**: SciRev search returned zero journal-specific results for PsycCRITIQUES (only unrelated psychology journals like Psychological Review/Science/Medicine appeared).
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: No SciRev entry and no forum discussion located for this title.
- **experiential.acceptance_note**: No first-hand author accounts located. Cross-language forum search (小木虫/知乎/Reddit) not run for 'current' submission experience because the journal has had no live submission pipeline for 8+ years, making any such thread definitionally non-existent for this purpose.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No concrete first-hand source found or expected for a title with no active review process since 2017.
- **preprint.allowed**: No journal-specific preprint policy page exists for a discontinued title; left null rather than inferring from APA's general stance.

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per WO2 rules):**
- 小木虫 (muchong.com), 知乎, fabiaoji, Reddit r/AskAcademia: not queried. Rationale: Wikipedia + APA's own database page both confirm the journal ceased publication/submissions on 2017-12-31 (8+ years before this 2026-07-13 work order), so 'current author experience' threads about submitting to it would be definitionally non-existent or off-topic. Running these queries would risk surfacing noise misattributed to this title rather than genuine signal.
- SciRev (English, general web search): queried "PsycCRITIQUES SciRev review time acceptance" — 0 journal-specific results; only unrelated psychology journals (Psychological Review, Science, Medicine) returned, corroborating no live discussion exists for this discontinued title.
